text: The Chair, Toronto Music Advisory Committee, will lead a discussion on updating and finalizing a list of immediate priorities with specific actions and timelines for focus during the present term of City Council.

The Toronto Music Advisory Committee recommends that: 1. The Economic and Community Development Committee request the Chief Planner and Executive Director, City Planning, and the Executive Director, Municipal Licensing and Standards, in consultation with other relevant City staff, to review zoning, licensing or other measures to allow live music venues to operate as dance studios, gyms, or other businesses that have been allowed to open under different measures or restrictions than live music venues, pursuant to Ontario’s COVID-19 response framework, and report on possible implementation to the Toronto Music Advisory Committee. 2.
